extendedData.value:
Have you seen the art for Presence of the Master? It rules. Of course it does—Phil Foglio’s been bringing unforgettable Magic art to life for decades. We teased a Secret Lair collab with him ages ago and guess what? The wait’s over. Celebrate one of Magic’s most iconic artists in the best way possible: by playing his whimsically wonderful, unapologetically Foglio-fied cards.
Contents:
• 1x Goblin Bombardment
• 1x Orcish Lumberjack
• 1x Constant Mists
• 1x Song of the Dryads

When purchasing this unique product, please keep in mind that this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product will ship out to you after the seller receives the product directly from Wizards of the Coast.

The estimated time frame for sellers to receive stock is not fixed, so it could be anywhere between 1 - 10 weeks for delivery.
